question: Does the development-locked FUSED3 selector remain linear-probe competitive for linear downstream transfer and strictly lower-regret for quadratic, kNN, and RBF transfer on five predeclared, previously uninspected backbone panels?

sampling.training: within each dataset replicate and class, a deterministic class-specific permutation from the frozen replicate seed; budget 32 is the exact prefix of budget 64
sampling.training_role: the same sampled target-training cohort is used for FUSED3 and LP-FULL OOF scoring and for fitting all four downstream reference heads
sampling.evaluation: exactly 20 deterministic rows per class from the official evaluation split using seed 2026082709, fixed across budgets and replicates
sampling.leakage_rule: no evaluation row or statistic may enter selector fitting, LP fitting, FUSED3 relevance/prototype fitting, or conditioning
sampling.replicate_interpretation: sampling-seed stability with possible overlap, not independent cohorts

FUSED3.input: float32 row-L2 normalized once before five stratified folds
FUSED3.score: mean of five held-out fixed OI scores
FUSED3.state_rule: centers owners and weights must be bit-exact before and after score_fixed

LP-FULL.folds: five shuffled stratified folds with random_state equal to replicate_seed

reference_heads.training: fit separately for each dataset backbone replicate and budget on exactly the sampled target-training cohort
reference_heads.evaluation: accuracy on the fixed 20-per-class official evaluation cohort

embedding_extraction.input: only the union of the frozen training and evaluation cohorts selected before extraction
embedding_extraction.identity: dataset source implementation archive split sample IDs labels extractor dependency versions provider recipes model checkpoint bytes processor/preprocessing bytes matrix bytes shape and dtype must be hash-bound
embedding_extraction.audited_registry: separate immutable input artifact outside code identity and required before any outcome run
embedding_extraction.missing_revision_policy: resolve cached files to exact content hashes; network model resolution after lineage freeze is forbidden
embedding_extraction.environment: Python 3.9.6, NumPy 2.0.2, torch 2.8.0, torchvision 0.23.0, timm 1.0.27, transformers 4.57.6, open_clip 2.32.0, Pillow 11.3.0, Vertebrae 1.0.0; CPU batch size 16 with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
embedding_extraction.source_identity: one external canonical source manifest per dataset containing every sorted relative path, byte size, and file SHA-256; the manifests are outside raw roots and hash-bound by the audited registry
embedding_extraction.model_lock: one closed ten-backbone mapping binds provider version, archived driver model ID, cached snapshot revision, checkpoint bytes, preprocessing package/config bytes, recipe hash, dimension, and dtype; every embedding record must match it exactly
embedding_extraction.image_loader: the code-owned load_union_images implementation validates each sample ID and label before returning raw images in the frozen union order; no injected production loader is allowed

authorization_chain.order: frozen protocol plus code plus exact V1 ancestry plus exact FUSED3 authority -> immutable lineage lock -> audited_complete registry binding that lock -> structural smoke -> full run
authorization_chain.readiness: input readiness is represented only by audited_registry.status=audited_complete; the lineage lock never changes when inputs become available
authorization_chain.parent_registry: audited registry parent_registry_sha256 must equal the lineage lock v1_confirmation_registry_sha256

execution.selector_order: two-method cyclic exact counterbalance; each method appears in each position 250 times
execution.checkpoint: one complete paired two-selector plus four-reference-head backbone panel written atomically
execution.resume: exact protocol code lineage registry environment cohort cache recipe and checkpoint identity only
execution.warmup: on the first frozen panel, execute one excluded warm-up first and record the second measured execution; compare their complete clock-free results including numeric outcomes exactly in memory, persist only exact=true, and persist matching hashes of an explicit outcome-free structural allowlist across resume
execution.preflight: validate all 50 embedding matrices and manifests, every source/weight/cohort identity, protocol/code/lineage/registry hashes, and the exact scoring environment before computing the first selector or reference outcome
execution.smoke_storage: structural smoke may compute one panel transiently but may persist only type/finite/identity descriptors and hashes of the explicit outcome-free structural allowlist; selector scores, reference accuracies, fold outcome values, timings, numeric checkpoints, rankings, and hashes derived from any such outcome are forbidden
execution.resource_preflight: outcome-redacted timing and memory only; it cannot change recipes datasets gates or execution

statistics.selection_ties: average downstream outcomes for all selector maxima equal within atol=1e-12
statistics.rank: Spearman with constant input represented as null undefined
statistics.rank_auc: two-budget normalized trapezoid over log2 budget; complete support only and supporting evidence only
statistics.bootstrap: resample datasets then complete replicate blocks; equal dataset equal replicate and equal budget weight; shared draws for all gates

confirmation_gates.linear: pooled upper95 FUSED3 minus LP-FULL regret <= 1.0 pp and no per-dataset point estimate averaged equally across frozen replicates and budgets > 2.0 pp
confirmation_gates.quadratic: pooled upper95 FUSED3 minus LP-FULL regret < 0 and at least 4 of 5 per-dataset point estimates averaged equally across replicates and budgets strictly favor FUSED3
confirmation_gates.rank_auc: supporting evidence only; constant-score or constant-outcome Spearman is stored as null/undefined, incomplete rank support is disclosed, and neither condition vetoes or changes the primary regret gates
confirmation_gates.runtime: inherit exact hash-bound passed FUSED3 full-Food per-call and full-panel resource gates; confirmation clocks are descriptive only

decision.pass: pass_confirmed when every primary gate passes
decision.fail: fail_locked_candidate when any primary gate fails

stop_rules.statistical: never stop early or redesign from interim confirmation outcomes; complete the frozen panel, then evaluate once
stop_rules.failure: no runner-up fallback fusion retuning dataset substitution exclusion added seed or reinterpretation

claim_scope: Untouched confirmation for the exact class-stratified same-distribution five-dataset ten-backbone budgets-32-and-64 panel and four frozen downstream heads. It is not a distribution-shift claim or a universal backbone-ranking guarantee.
